name: Watermark Generator
overview: This python script creates a GUI to load an image and save it with a watermark on it.
details: The python script relies on tkinter to create a GUI for working with image files. The GUI is set up with four functionalities. The first is to upload a photo with user-specified dimensions. Second, the user can add a watermark which appears in the middle of the image. Third, the user can save the image as a .png file. Finally, the user can clear the prior image in order to load another.
